ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Active Directory Enumeration Using AD Module - PsModule
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of the "Import-Module" cmdlet to load the "Microsoft.ActiveDirectory.Management.dl" DLL. Which is often used by attackers to perform AD enumeration. Note: Unmapped fields: Payload

sequences.query: ((Payload = RGX(".*Import\\-Module\\ .*") OR Payload = RGX(".*ipmo\\ .*")) AND Payload = RGX(".*Microsoft\\\.ActiveDirectory\\\.Management\\\.dll.*"))
